findings.title: Impact carried into heat
findings.claim: The surah's announced striking event is carried into the terminal fire as a continuing, heated blow.
findings.mechanism: The focus fire and intense heat are the carriers; the repeated striking name in 101:1-2 supplies the independent percussion frame, so the final fire becomes the event's delivered impact rather than a detached later object.
findings.reader_payoff: The last phrase can be felt as the impact arriving and continuing as heat.
findings.containment: Literal hot fire remains intact. This does not decide whether the striking name primarily names the whole day or only the event's impact.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace names focus words 1-2, context ayahs 101:1-2, roots, roles, and the changed reading. Its legacy_unbound provenance qualifies the claim but does not suppress the attributed activation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Işık veren ve hızlı, kararsız hareket gösteren yanan ateş temel anlamdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun نارٌ carries the supplied burning-fire form.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The repeated القارعة frame in 101:1-2 supplies striking and impact.
branch_activations.activation: The terminal fire is the material form into which the announced blow arrives.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Impact persists as surging heat.
branch_activations.boundary: Literal combustion remains primary; the fire is not reduced to a metaphor for striking.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir etki belirgin bir keskinlik, sertlik ve şiddet taşır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus adjective حاميةٌ carries the supplied sharp-intensity core.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The repeated striking frame supplies an independent event to receive and extend the heat.
branch_activations.activation: Sharp heat gives the impact duration and sensory force.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Impact continues as a thermal assault.
branch_activations.boundary: The intensity branch is retained as attributed pressure, not a claim that every sharpness use means physical heat.
